children: Ashoka Buildcon share price will remain in focus on November 23 after the company, along with its joint venture partner SAM India, emerged as the lowest bidder (L1) for two projects worth a combined Rs 2,758 crore.

The projects, awarded by Rajasthan Metro Rail Corporation, involve the design and construction of elevated viaducts and elevated stations, including architectural finishing, under Jaipur Metro Phase II MRTS Packages 3 and 4.
Catch all the market action on our live blog

The latest order win adds to the company's recent project pipeline. Last week, Ashoka Buildcon secured a Rs 1,465 crore contract from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) for balance construction work on an eight-lane, access-controlled expressway on the Vadodara-Mumbai Expressway in Gujarat.

Earlier this month, the company received a Letter of Acceptance (LoA) from Druk Green Power Corporation Limited, Bhutan, for the design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of a 120 MWp Wobthang Solar PV Power Plant. The project is valued at USD 58.90 million.
In the previous trading session, the share closed Rs 110.94, down Rs 2.31, or 2.04 percent.
The share touched a 52-week high of Rs 187.20 and a 52-week low of Rs 95.40 on 27 November, 2025 and 29 October, 2026, respectively.
Currently, the stock is trading 40.85 percent below its 52-week high and 16.06 percent above its 52-week low.
The market capitalisation of the company stands at Rs 3,114.34 crore.

title: Ashoka Buildcon shares in focus as JV emerges lowest bidder for Jaipur Metro projects
